content: Ngwiiyà a Yɛsu
Ungö ilä a saba, Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà, anà Sàlomɛ anà Màlye ngwän a Zyak, bàsöm may a usɔŋ ntɔn mumwaŋ u ndür a Yɛsu.
Ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà, ba bàkyen an'dii u tutu, mpal làsɛnà taaŋ.
Ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Nà akà ibuum nkɔŋ yinà u mun a an'dii? »
Wɛɛ umpal bàler ba, ba bàmɛn naa nkɔŋ yàkäl aŋàbuum ukɔl.
Ba bàbilà uboo a an'dii, bàmɛn un'tö mwɛy wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ ibaal, akyàbwaar mvwɛl a pɛɛl. Matɛɛr waa mawɛl.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Twon lan'man bɔɔmà, bɛ làwàmuleŋ Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi. Nde akyàwiyà, nde ufàkal anki apà. Làler ikal bun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Wɛɛ làkyen kàlakyään alɔŋki ande, anà Petɔlà sye, naa: "Nde amàkaladil u Ngalilɛ. Bɛ làyàkun'man kwo, asànaa kàlakyään nde." »
Apan, ba bàtoo, waa bàtiin ukwɛl a an'dii, ntɔn matɛɛr anà lingyoomà màkyer awal. Ba bàkyään anki itàkal undiir mwɛy akà mbuur umwɛy, ntɔn ba bàkäl u bɔɔmà.
Yɛsu an'kàmɛnà akà Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà
Ungö a ngwiiyà ande kà ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà u tutu, Yɛsu kàtwab akàmɛnà akà Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà awà kàböŋ nde an'dwelà an'be, an'dweelà nsambwaar.
Nde kàkàkyään ndaa ayi akà baar bàkälà anà nde. Ba bàkälà u ngyɛb anà mulelà.
Wɛɛ mpal bàwem ba nde wàmutɛɛnà naa: « Yɛsu wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, mɛ in'kyun'man! », ba bun'si anki làkwikilà.
Yɛsu an'kàmɛnà akà alɔŋki abɔ̈ɔ̈l
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkàmɛnà ifà asin akalɔŋki abɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl u mbwo mukyà ndwaŋ.
Ba bàyàfurà, waa bàkyään ya akà bumwɛy. Wɛɛ ba, ba sye basi anki làkwikilà.
Yɛsu an'kàmɛnà akà Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkàmɛnà akà Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy umpal bàkäl ba mudyà, waa kapɛl ntɔn bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ba làkwikilà anà ntɔn bwoor a mpem aba bàtön ba mukyey baar bun'mɛn wàŋàwiyà.
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkyen u mɛɛn manswà mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ akà nkyeer yanswà.
Mbuur asàsà làkwikilà anà asàwal ndüümà, nde asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ mbuur mpa asàsà làkwikilà, nde bàsun'tsüül mbar.
Làler idiim isaswaŋà naa baar bà bàkyàsà làkwikilà: Kà ikɔb amɛ ba bàsàböŋ insɔŋà, ba bàsàtɛn ndaa a kün,
ba bàsàtà ntäy mpi kà an'kɔɔ, bàsànwà ipöm, wɛɛ kyà ube isakyer anki, ba bàsàsà abɛy an'kɔɔ, waa ba bàsàkɔɔrà. »
Yɛsu kan'furà akà Taa
Abun, ungö muyäm anà ba, Mwol Yɛsu bun'syen du, waa kàbwaay u kɔɔ a Nzam là ibaal.
Wɛɛ akà ba, ba bàkyen mukàkyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ u mɛɛn manswà. Mwol kàsälà anà ba, waa kàtää imbäl u mbwo a idiim a impà kàkyerà nde muswaŋ naa an'lɔɔŋ aba mà ndandaa.
